description: Discrete ground controls: hold, move toward the assigned objective, or approach/fire at a fixed enemy target using its latest shared reconnaissance track.

actions.name: MOVE_TOWARD_OBJECTIVE
actions.description: Move at most five kilometers toward the assigned ground objective.

actions.name: ATTACK_TARGET_1
actions.description: Move toward the target's latest shared reconnaissance position; fire instead when current geometry is within ground-weapon range.
